findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Young Serif and Source Serif 4, but the page renders -apple-system, Songti TC.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 3654px of nothing between: "工坊作品"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("培育鑽石 訂造攻略") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.
